newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - March 14.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - March 14.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
Engine developer reported a wider first half loss, slipping to A$93.92 milion from A$17.77 million.
Pay TV operator in active trade on Thursday as speculation mounts of rationalisation moves in the loss-ridden sector.

Gold miners St Barbara said on Wednesday it proposed to merge with fellow gold miner Mt Leyshon, the offer being 32 St Barbara shares for every 10 Mt Leyshon shares. Mt Leyshon, owned 75 percent by the Normandy Mining said it was receptive to the offer but advised shareholders to await a formal offer.
Hotel group will release annual profit result today.
Various newspapers report that Seven and other Optus Vision shareholders are nearing an agreement which could sidestep legal action over ownership.

Village announced a mop-up bid for Austereo near the end of trade on Thursday, with the A$190 million bid to be funded in part by share placements to key stockholders. Austereo has made no comment on the bid for the outstanding 48 percent of its shares.
